ns2:course.label: Technology Entrepreneurship
ns2:course.description: Critical factors affecting technology-based ventures: opportunity assessment; the entrepreneurial process; founders and team building; preparation of a business plan including market research, marketing and sales, finance, and manufacturing considerations. Same as TE 461. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MATH 231.
